display.title: Episode 505: The Tall Chanukah Candles (Chanukah)
display.summary_short: A Chanukah show with Chanukah songs in three languages, a first-grade class celebrating the Aleph-Beis, and the story of a Chassid whose three-foot-tall Chanukah candles saved his life.
display.summary_long: Broadcast during Chanukah. A guest singer in Studio 604 leads Chanukah songs in English ('I Have a Little Dreidel'), Hebrew and Yiddish. Uncle Yossi explains that Torah and mitzvos are light, and welcomes a first-grade class from a Boro Park girls' school that has just finished learning the Aleph-Beis and is ready for the Siddur. The girls sing a song saying goodbye to the Aleph-Beis, lead the Shema, and sing the Al Hamichyah blessing, and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time: the jolly Chassid Naftali explains why he dances on Chanukah. Before a winter journey, his Rebbe, the Rebbe Rashab, told him to buy Chanukah candles three feet tall. Stranded by a blizzard on the first night and caught by robbers, he lit the tall candles on top of his wagon, and firemen watching for forest fires saw the flames and rode up, scaring the robbers away. Uncle Yossi adds the Rebbe's teaching that the Chanukah lights whisper a message of emunah and bitachon, leads a prayer for a sick person, and gives the times for lighting the menorah before Shabbos candles on Friday.
display.lesson: The Chanukah lights teach emunah and bitachon in Hashem, the Master of Miracles; follow a tzaddik's advice even when you don't understand it.

date.note: 'Here we are celebrating Chanukah'; Friday menorah before Shabbos candles (4:11). One week after episode 504 (19 Kislev); 26 Kislev 5752 = 2nd day of Chanukah.

advisories.note: Robbers stop a traveler and tell him to say his last prayers; he is rescued.
